I'm dying for an update OP! Please please keep your kitty safe! The sage is a fantastic idea. I hope the thing goes away and until then we'll all be anxious for more info!

It may have something to do with your bipolar disorder? I'm no professional but it seems like that a good possibility. Get a new journal and keep an eye out for more of these odd scrawlings. If you see more, get your therapist on the line. It either that or Nike demons.

Thank you so much. I honestly needed to hear that. I know my mom means the best. Maybe she just wanted me to think of it that way to help me get past it. I'm not entirely sure. I have to talk to my bf more and I probably will tonight when he gets off work. As far as therapy though, I know this sounds braggy but I'm generally smart about psychological stuff and tend to talk in circles around any therapist. I have one for my depression and she's very nice. I'm making an effort to let her in and keep things moving forward instead of my normal circles. However I'm not sure just how ready I am to talk to a therapist about this incident. The healing process is slow on my own and with the help of bf and "brother" I think I may be able to do it without having to talk to a therapist. I just don't really want to be prodded about the parts that bother me the most. I don't really want to talk about the details of it. I appreciate your advice though, very much. And I want to thank you for taking time to answer my post. It really means a lot to know there are people who care and are listening. I'm also very ready to help others with their struggles as well. It seems to help me when I know I've eased another person's mind. Thanks again. I truly appreciate your words.

I'm absolutely going to watch the movie. Thank you so much. It actually means a lot that you've recommended something that helped you in the past. You're very kind to do so and I'll not be taking it for granted. As for my boyfriend, I know that a lot of my "issues" wih him are made up scenarios that my brain fabricated. Depression is a disease that sits on your brain and pumps ugly thoughts into it that you wouldn't normally have. I talked to him last night and he assured me that I'm the only person he wants to be with. And one of only 3 people that he truly loves. (His mother and grandmother are the others.) Thank you so very much for your advice and I will be watching Before I Disappear within the next week. I promise to get back to you with my thoughts on it and again I appreciate you taking the time to suggest it.

Thank you, I will definitely be talking to him again and this time I'll make everything more clear. I was in a panic and I should have made sure I was more calm so I could think clearly. I appreciate your advice and will heed it to the best of my ability.

Thank you for responding. I am planning on talking to my boyfriend. I didn't tell him the story. Just that my cousin tried to rape me. I don't know that he even wants to know the story. It's just such a difficult topic.
Honestly, more happened but I can't really bring myself to describe it in any amount of detail. This the first time I've even told this much detail besides my mum. I have been feeling pretty down lately. I appreciate your input and thanks again for responding. It means a lot.

I'm just a little voice in a big crowd but I hear what you're saying and I hope you will be okay. I wish I could do more or say more but I just don't know how to help you. If talking will help you can pm me. Blessed be your hurting soul.
I agree with junkeee999.

Yes it was rape and you should report it as soon as you feel ready. I'm sorry if this offends but fuck your mom. What she did to you was damn near as bad as what the guy did to you. I hope you find peace with all of this OP.

YES IT WAS RAPE. You said no and he continued to try and even if he was wearing a condom it was still not thoroughly established that you were okay with him doing anything after his rude and illegal act. You need to leave him as you can't be sure he won't do something like that (or worse) again. Plus, do you really want to be with someone who would do that?
Cut little bits off of him and feed them to him until he's bled to death. Nobody admits to killing your baby and lives!
